title: workflow.step.requested payload
description: Emitted by BMS when a workflow instance reaches a step that another service must perform. Consumed by the target service and Logging. Concrete command steps are realized by issuing the target service's own command (e.g. a transcode step issues transcode.job.create); this event is the observable record that BMS requested the step.

definitionId.description: The published workflow definition this instance runs.

stepId.description: Node id within the workflow definition (NCName).

stepKind.description: Matches the workflow-definition node kind driving this step.

target.description: The service expected to act (e.g. "mts", "hsm"). Absent for internal steps.

assetId.description: The asset in flow, when the step is asset-scoped.

params.description: Step-specific parameters; the target validates them against its own command contract.
